from pathlib import Path

s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1][0]
    two = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2][0]
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    nr, nc = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    # Trace diagonally from 1 until one coordinate is one cell short,
    # then continue on the axis with the larger remaining displacement.
    steps = min(nr, nc) - 1
    for k in range(1, steps + 1):
        out[r + dr*k][c + dc*k] = 3
    r += dr*steps
    c += dc*steps
    while abs(tr-r) + abs(tc-c) > 1:
        if abs(tr-r) >= abs(tc-c):
            r += dr
        else:
            c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
